recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-16317 unless a future work group separately chooses to expand the current concise description, which would be editorially distinct from this truncation fix.
issue_request: FHIR-16317 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction for FHIR-core Conformance. It reported that the FHIR versions value set description in the 2018May build ended mid-sentence and should explain why the extensible value set can change as published FHIR versions are added.
initial_application: The Jira comments identify svn 14427, represented in git by 29a63b7dca5932bb2eee2c1454ad20e23a117b71. That commit changed both source/terminologies/valueset-fhir-versions.xml and source/terminologies/codesystem-fhir-versions.xml from truncated descriptions to complete text ending with 'the list of published versions will change over time.'
additional_context: The old fixed fhir-versions files were later deleted, and the current build uses the refactored FHIR-version artifact under source/capabilitystatement. source/fhir.ini includes capabilitystatement as an active resource. Current source/capabilitystatement/codesystem-FHIR-version.xml and the FHIR-version binding descriptions say 'All published FHIR Versions.' Build.fhir.org current JSON for ValueSet/FHIR-version and CodeSystem/FHIR-version shows the same complete description. Community searches found no substantive Zulip or Confluence discussion contradicting the source/history conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The original typo was applied in historical source, and the current authoritative source and current build surface no longer contain the truncated sentence.
